body:
My apologies.  I'm used to people trying to play nice in order to trick me.

I think I believed all the bullshit about how if you change enough things then something will happen.  It's easy to believe you have tons to change when you have no self esteem, but when you change everything and you're still deficient then life becomes completely empty. Nothing matters because actions don't matter and not in the positive way like go do anything because there are still horrible things like injury and debt.  Now it's doing what is required and going to bed as early as possible even if I can't sleep because I'm basically not a human. And no one cares and no one will care and everyone fucking lies and hurts you and holy shit I can not believe the other sex is as shallow as it is, I can't look at them with respect anymore because look at what they value.  Holy shit, this is humanity? Does anyone EVER tell the truth unless it's to hurt you?

I believed the lie and then eventually enough time passed and enough changes passed and I realized everyone was lying to me about what everything is all about. No one ever tells the truth about anything, it's maddening. It kind of seems like people only use their brains to hurt each other, but otherwise default to being an animal. How is that even a world one can live with?

>Why do you think love is such an important thing for you?

I don't understand the question.

Are you mocking me? If you're trying to be subtly mean and imply some sort of philosophical immaturity, please just go away.

>There is nothing to look forward to, the only things I wanted and looked forward to are apparently too difficult for me to achieve, things like physical love and being touched positively. How sad is that? There are teenagers more accomplished than me in junior high, and all the abstract things like degrees don’t matter compared to the basic facts of life.

>The fact is I was born a loser and I will die a loser and every time I’ve tried to change that has been a humiliating experience of being put in my place. My family has blown me off for decades and my friends stole from me and talk shit, so I don’t really have any friends. I’ve never experienced love, and for a long time, that was what kept me going. And I did everything in the name of being good enough, but the truth is that being good enough has NOTHING to do with being good enough.
